verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source code is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a chat platform like Discord, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Discord publishing its source code or any license. The docs cover APIs, SDKs, webhooks and Nitro features only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
